Func.name: abstract
Func.desc: Defines an abstract class or method that must be implemented in derived classes.

Func.name: as
Func.desc: Used for casting an object to a specific type.

Func.name: base
Func.desc: Refers to the base class of the current instance.

Func.name: bool
Func.desc: Represents a Boolean value (true or false).

Func.name: break
Func.desc: Exits from a loop or switch statement.

Func.name: byte
Func.desc: Represents an 8-bit unsigned integer.

Func.name: case
Func.desc: Defines a branch in a switch statement.

Func.name: catch
Func.desc: Declares a block of code, known as an exception handler, that can handle exceptions thrown by try blocks.

Func.name: char
Func.desc: Represents a single 16-bit Unicode character.

Func.name: checked
Func.desc: Enables overflow checking for integral types.

Func.name: class
Func.desc: Declares a class.

Func.name: const
Func.desc: Declares a constant field or local variable.

Func.name: continue
Func.desc: Skips the current iteration of a loop and proceeds to the next iteration.

Func.name: decimal
Func.desc: Represents a 128-bit precise decimal value with 28-29 significant digits.

Func.name: default
Func.desc: Specifies the default value of a type or the default case in a switch statement.

Func.name: delegate
Func.desc: Declares a delegate type, which is a reference type that can encapsulate methods with specific signatures.

Func.name: do
Func.desc: Starts a do-while loop that executes at least once before checking its condition.

Func.name: double
Func.desc: Represents a double-precision floating-point number.

Func.name: else
Func.desc: Specifies an alternative block of code to execute if the condition in an if statement is false.

Func.name: enum
Func.desc: Declares an enumeration, which is a distinct type consisting of a set of named constants.

Func.name: event
Func.desc: Declares an event, which is a message sent by an object to signal the occurrence of an action.

Func.name: explicit
Func.desc: Indicates that a conversion operator requires an explicit cast to be invoked.

Func.name: extern
Func.desc: Indicates that the method is implemented externally (e.g., in another assembly).

Func.name: false
Func.desc: Represents the Boolean value false.

Func.name: finally
Func.desc: Declares a block of code that will execute after try and catch blocks, regardless of whether an exception was thrown.

Func.name: fixed
Func.desc: Pins a variable in place so that it can be accessed by pointer operations without being moved by garbage collection.

Func.name: float
Func.desc: Represents a single-precision floating-point number.

Func.name: for
Func.desc: Initiates a for loop, which executes statements repeatedly based on specified conditions.

Func.name: foreach
Func.desc: Iterates through each element in a collection or array.

Func.name: goto
Func.desc: Transfers control to another part of the program, identified by a label.

Func.name: if
Func.desc: Executes statements based on whether a specified condition evaluates to true or false.

Func.name: implicit
Func.desc: Indicates that a conversion operator can be invoked without an explicit cast.

Func.name: in
Func.desc: Used in foreach loops and specifies input parameters in method signatures (in parameter).

Func.name: int
Func.desc: Represents a signed 32-bit integer type.

Func.name: interface
Func.desc: Declares an interface, which is a contract that classes can implement.

Func.name: internal
Func.desc: Specifies that access is limited to the current assembly.

Func.name: is
Func.desc: Checks if an object is compatible with a given type and performs casting if it is compatible.

Func.name: lock
Func.desc: Acquires the mutual-exclusion lock for a specified object, preventing other threads from accessing it until released.

Func.name: long
Func.desc: Represents a signed 64-bit integer type.

Func.name: namespace
Func.desc: Declares a scope that contains a set of related objects, such as classes and interfaces.

Func.name: new
Func.desc: Creates objects or hides members inherited from base classes; also used to declare constructors.

Func.name: null
Func.desc: Represents the absence of any object or value; it is not initialized yet.

Func.name: object
Func.desc: The base type from which all other types derive; represents any data type in C#.

Func.name: operator
Func.desc: Defines user-defined operators for custom types or overloads existing operators for types defined by the user.

Func.name: out
Func.desc: Indicates that an argument is passed by reference and will be initialized within the called method.

Func.name: override
Func.desc: Modifies the implementation of an inherited member from the base class.

Func.name: params
Func.desc: Allows you to specify a variable number of arguments for methods.

Func.name: private
Func.desc: Restricts access to members within the containing class only.

Func.name: protected
Func.desc: Restricts access to members within derived classes and containing classes.

Func.name: public
Func.desc: Allows access to members from any other code.

Func.name: readonly
Func.desc: Indicates that fields can only be assigned during declaration or within constructors.

Func.name: ref
Func.desc: Indicates that an argument is passed by reference.

Func.name: return
Func.desc: Exits from the current method and optionally returns a value.

Func.name: sbyte
Func.desc: Represents an 8-bit signed integer.

Func.name: sealed
Func.desc: Prevents other classes from inheriting from it.

Func.name: short
Func.desc: Represents a signed 16-bit integer.

Func.name: sizeof
Func.desc: Returns the size in bytes of any data type.
